items.q: What should I prepare before reaching out?
items.a: A few reference images, rough dimensions, and a sense of timeline are enough to start. If you're mid-renovation, existing floor plans help us scope the work faster.

items.q: Can this start as a small project?
items.a: Yes. Many of our clients begin with a single piece or a small repair before moving into larger renovation or rental work — we scale with what you need.

items.q: Do you work with existing brands?
items.a: We regularly build to match an existing brand's materials, finishes, or spatial language — send us what you have and we'll design around it.
Once we understand the project, most inquiries get a scoped proposal within a week. Build timelines vary by complexity and are confirmed before work begins.

items.q: Do you handle structural repairs, not just finishing?
items.a: Yes — our structural specialists assess load-bearing changes, framing, and repair work alongside the finish carpentry.

items.q: Can I attach photos when I send an inquiry?
items.a: Yes, the renovation & maintenance inquiry form includes an optional photo upload so we can see the space before the first call.

items.q: Do you offer ongoing maintenance contracts?
items.a: For commercial spaces especially, yes — we can scope a recurring maintenance arrangement once the initial work is complete.

items.q: Can you build from my own design or sketch?
items.a: Yes — send what you have, even a rough sketch, and we'll refine it into a build-ready plan.

items.q: What's the typical lead time on custom pieces?
items.a: It depends on complexity, but most custom product builds run 3–6 weeks from confirmed design to delivery.

items.q: Do you deliver and set up rental structures?
items.a: Yes, delivery, setup, and teardown are included with every rental booking.

items.q: How far in advance should I book for a wedding?
items.a: We recommend booking 2–3 months ahead for peak wedding season to guarantee availability of specific pieces.
